- Coordinating multi-disciplinary design documentation as required for the road infrastructure projects, ensuring design documents are delivered with high quality, within project timelines and budget and in accordance with the engineering and drafting requirements.
- Associate Diploma in Civil Engineering Design/Drafting or equivalent relevant qualification is mandatory

- Proficiency in the use of digital engineering tools and platforms required for design/drafting and management of road infrastructure project documentation (MicroStation, Open Roads, 12D, AutoCAD, ProjectWise, GIS).

- Experience in interpreting and implementing design information provided by the design engineers with solid knowledge of DTP Infrastructure Drafting Standards, documented management and handover requirements, including an understanding of Austroads, DTP and Australian design and drafting standards for road infrastructure projects.
